suggestions.expectation: brief.md reports the state of the tree and the sessions as findings (branch name; which sessions are open — SES-004 and SES-005 in this fixture — …)
suggestions.reason: The parenthetical is stale for fixtures-5: SES-004 is closed here and only SES-005 is open. A run that dutifully reported 'SES-004 and SES-005 open' would be wrong yet match the text. Rewrite as 'which sessions `bun run session list` reports open' so the grader derives the truth from the fixture, as was needed for expectation 4.

suggestions.expectation: brief.md contains a line starting with 'read in full:' that names docs/OVERVIEW.md, CONTEXT.md and the newest SES file, and transcript.md shows each of those was read to its last line
suggestions.reason: Both halves rest on the executor's own transcript. The transcript is written by the run being graded, so 'reached the end' is self-reported; a fabricated table would pass. If the harness can capture the raw tool log (or the persisted tool-result paths it cites), point the expectation at that instead. Also decide whether basename shorthand ('OVERVIEW') satisfies 'names docs/OVERVIEW.md' — it passed here on unambiguity, but the text implies a path.

The brief correctly contradicts OVERVIEW.md ('local branch wip/visual-grouping') with the fixture truth ('only origin/…, no local branch'). No expectation rewards noticing a docs-vs-repo discrepancy, which is exactly the rehydration failure mode this skill exists to catch; consider an expectation that the brief flags any Status/Next-up claim the tree contradicts.

eval_feedback.overall: All eight passed on genuine evidence, and the new facts-true-at-end expectation did real work (every sha, count, branch and test figure was rechecked against the fixture). Two parentheticals are fixture-stale and the read-in-full check leans on self-report.
